sloka: मतंगेन तदा शप्तो हि अस्मिन् आश्रम मण्डले ।प्रविशेत् यदि वै वाली मूर्धा अस्य शतधा भवेत् ॥४-४६-२२॥
transliteration: mataṁgena tadā śapto hi asmin āśrama maṇḍale ।praviśet yadi vai vālī mūrdhā asya śatadhā bhavet ॥4-46-22॥

translations.english: 'I remembed Matanga's curse to Vali, king of monkeys. Vali would not enter the site of Matanga's hermitage as his head would break into a hundred pieces if he did'. Therefore we thought it would be safe for us to reside in that place.
translations.hindi: इदानीं मे स्मृतं राजन्‌ यथा वाली हरीश्वरः । मतङ्गेन तदा शक्तो द्यस्मिन्नाश्रममण्डले
